**Observation Log:**

[FACT] User attended a 3-day project management workshop last month.  
[PREFERENCE] User is looking to organize their upcoming project more efficiently.  
[PREFERENCE] User is interested in project management tools that support Agile methodologies and Scrum framework.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Jira is developed by Atlassian and is widely used for Agile project management, offering features for Scrum, Kanban, and other Agile frameworks.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Trello is a visual project management tool that uses boards, lists, and cards to organize tasks and supports Agile methodologies like Scrum and Kanban.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Asana is a work management platform that supports Agile project management with customizable workflows, tasks, and reporting.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Microsoft Azure DevOps supports Agile project management, including Scrum, with features like boards, backlogs, and sprints.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Smartsheet supports Agile methodologies, including Scrum, with a grid-based interface and customizable workflows.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Wrike supports Agile project management with features like boards, workflows, and resource allocation.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] monday.com is a work operating system that supports Agile project management, including Scrum, with customizable boards and workflows.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] VersionOne is designed specifically for Agile and Scrum teams, offering boards, backlogs, sprints, and reporting.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] CA Agile Central (formerly Rally) supports Agile methodologies, including Scrum, with boards, backlogs, and reporting.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Pivotal Tracker supports Agile project management, including Scrum, with boards, workflows, and iteration planning.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Factors to consider when choosing a project management tool include team size, customization needs, integration, scalability, user experience, and cost.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Jira offers a free plan for up to 10 users with unlimited projects, basic agile project planning, and 2 GB of file storage.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Jira's Standard plan costs $7 per user/month (billed annually) for 11-100 users, adding advanced agile project planning and 250 GB of file storage.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Jira's Premium plan costs $14 per user/month (billed annually) for 11-100 users, adding advanced roadmaps and 1 TB of file storage.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Jira offers a 7-day free trial for new customers with access to all features, including those in the Premium plan.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Trello offers a free plan with unlimited boards, lists, and cards, and 250 MB of file storage.
